nodes.name: Mark notification succeeded
nodes.notes: Only a 2xx notification response is persisted as succeeded. Reserved entries are retried with the same Idempotency-Key.

nodes.name: Reserve notification idempotency
nodes.notes: Reserves eventId + idempotencyKey in workflow static data before contacting the notification channel. Do not clear this ledger.

nodes.name: Notify allowed recipients
nodes.notes: Select an HTTP Header Auth credential owned by n8n for the notification channel. No credential is embedded in this export.

nodes.name: Sign success callback
nodes.notes: Select the Crypto credential whose HMAC secret matches N8N_CALLBACK_SECRET.
